project.name: FrinStore
project.description: Local ice cream online marketplace: Vue 3 SPA (frinstore_frontend) + FastAPI REST API (frinstore_backend) with SQLite (frinstore.db), JWT auth, customer storefront and admin dashboard.

test_plan_identifier.title: Test Plan Identifier
test_plan_identifier.authors: Omadley (Team Leader); Moleta; Butad; Tamera; Ancog

revision_history.change: Initial pre-final test plan for FrinStore.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.purpose: Define how Group 6 will verify that FrinStore meets documented functional and non-functional expectations before pre-final submission.
references: FastAPI auto-generated OpenAPI at /docs when API is running

scope.title: Scope
in_scope: Customer registration, login, JWT session behavior
Catalog browsing (API-backed), product detail, client-side search/filter as implemented
Shopping cart persistence and checkout for authenticated customers
Order creation (FS- order id), order listing for the owning customer
Admin product CRUD and admin order status updates
Role separation: guest vs customer vs admin (UI routes + API 401/403)
out_of_scope_for_this_test_cycle: Live payment gateway capture (methods are recorded only)
Formal load test to 500 concurrent users

features_to_be_tested.title: Features To Be Tested (user view + risk)

rows.feature: Health check, responsive layout, empty/error states

rows.reason: Not implemented; payment method stored for fulfillment only.
Adapter may be stubbed; verify only if implemented in build.

rows.feature: Sales analytics beyond what UI exposes
rows.reason: Report depth may be limited; document actual behavior.

approach.title: Approach / Strategy
methods: Automated: pytest with FastAPI TestClient against SQLite test DB (see 03_system_test_report.json evidence section).
Manual system: execute Doc 2 cases in Chrome/Edge against local or deployed URL.
UAT: non-developer testers execute business scenarios in 04_uat_plan_and_report.json.
metrics: Test case pass rate by module

item_pass_fail_criteria.title: Item Pass/Fail Criteria
criteria: A test case passes when observed UI/API behavior matches expected result with no blocking defect.
Critical failures in authentication, checkout, or admin inventory block conditional sign-off.
Cosmetic issues alone do not fail critical path if business data remains correct.

suspension_and_resumption.title: Suspension Criteria and Resumption Requirements
resume_after: Smoke tests pass (health, login, one product load)

tasks.task: Execute Doc 2 manual cases + log results
Run pytest + record in system report

environmental_needs.title: Environmental Needs
environmental_needs.hardware_os: Windows 10/11 PC with 8 GB+ RAM recommended
environmental_needs.software: Node.js 18+, Python 3.12+, Chrome or Edge (current stable)
environmental_needs.network: localhost or HTTPS deployment; Vite dev proxy to API on 127.0.0.1:8000
environmental_needs.test_data: Seeded admin admin@frinstore.com / admin123; dedicated UAT customer accounts (do not use production PII).

staffing_and_training.title: Staffing and Training Needs
staffing_and_training.text: UAT testers receive a one-page script: URLs, test customer registration steps, and forbidden actions (no destructive admin tests without reset plan).

rows.mitigation: Record screen or API logs as evidence.

rows.risk: SQLite file lock under parallel testing
rows.mitigation: Serialize tests; copy DB for demos if needed.
